metadata.title: 🔥 Whoomply Whispers: The Cartoon Roast-Off No Adult Comedian Can Handle 😭😂
metadata.description: I swear these animated boy-and-girl cuties are *way* funnier than most adult comedians—like, how is that even possible?! 🤣 In this episode, they go back and forth with the most unexpected little roasts and hilarious comebacks you’ll hear all day. The jokes land so fast you’ll be rewinding just to catch the punchlines! Like if these kids are funnier than comedians! Comment who won—Team Boy or Team Girl—and don’t forget to Follow Whoomply Whispers for more animated chaos. #animated #cartoon #comedy #funny #kids #roast #hilarious #viral #trending #animation
